description: Canonical: well-formed outlier_value finding. Age=9999 is a clear sentinel/junk value.

finding.description: Field 'age' contains the sentinel value 9999 on a small but non-trivial slice — implausible as a real human age.
finding.hypothesis: Upstream form treats 9999 as 'unknown' instead of leaving the field null, leaking the sentinel into stored data.
